# Sanidhya Naturopathy Center

> Sanidhya Naturopathy Center is a naturopathy centre in Sector I, Jankipuram, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It offers natural wellness consultations and traditional natural therapies, with a 4.7/5 rating from 48 Google reviews.

- Address: H-D/98, Sector I Main Road, Sector I, Janki Vihar Colony, Jankipuram, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226021, India
- Phone: +91 94150 26684
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–9:30 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM–2:00 PM (Asia/Kolkata)
- Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJJ80omK1XmTkRSp7MzWn02MU
- Google Reviews: https://search.google.com/local/reviews?placeid=ChIJJ80omK1XmTkRSp7MzWn02MU

## Services

- Naturopathy consultations and holistic wellness planning
- Hydrotherapy (hip baths, spinal sprays, compresses)
- Mud therapy (solar-prepared)
- Herbal steam bath
- Acupressure and Sujok reflexology
- Therapeutic yoga, Yoga Nidra and guided meditation
- Diet and nutrition guidance
- Usui Reiki Level I and Level II certificate courses
